req.title: List cookies
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /cookies with a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request.

doc.reasoning: The view_cookies handler reads request.cookies, filters ENV_COOKIES when hide_env=True and show_env not in args, then returns jsonify(cookies=cookies). Tests must cover: (1) positive - cookies present are echoed exactly; (2) negative - no cookies yields empty dict; (3) boundary - single cookie at the edge of presence/absence; (4) multiple cookies; (5) show_env query param behaviour; (6) exact JSON structure with 'cookies' key. Mutation targets: the 'cookies' key name, the dict-building logic, the hide_env branch, and the HTTP 200 status code.

tests.name: test_get_cookies_with_single_cookie_returns_exact_value
preconditions: One cookie is set on the request
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing one name=value pair
expected: cookies dict contains exactly the sent cookie with exact value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_with_single_cookie_returns_exact_value():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'session=abc123'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data is not None
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'session': 'abc123'}

test_get_cookies_with_single_cookie_returns_exact_value()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_two_cookies_boundary_count_exactly_two
actions: Send GET /cookies with exactly two cookies
expected: cookies dict has exactly 2 entries with correct keys and values
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_two_cookies_boundary_count_exactly_two():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'first=alpha; second=beta'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 2
    assert data['cookies']['first'] == 'alpha'
    assert data['cookies']['second'] == 'beta'
    assert data['cookies'] == {'first': 'alpha', 'second': 'beta'}
